title: Excellent plan to get to know Ronda from Seville.
text: Merce gave us very good historical guides on the way to Ronda, and although the group was large, she handled it very well. The return trip, the next day, was with Carmela, who contacted us beforehand to coordinate the return and was very kind.
author: GJABustamante

title: Ronda - Full of Surprises!!
text: A wonderful day through the Spanish countryside to explore the White Villages - plus an authentic Olive Mill - and Ronda. We chose to stay overnight in Ronda and the Tour Company of Naturanda made all of the arrangements for us. Our group leader walked us to a beautiful hotel just around the corner from the famous bridge. Our room was lovely and the breakfast the next morning - facing out to the famous bridge!! - was plentiful and delicious! title: Best Guide in the world Antonio Javier Caballos
text:
I usually don’t like guided tours and never join them, but I went on this one with my mom — and I absolutely loved it! Our tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable, not only about the places we visited but also about many other topics. He shared so much interesting information, even beyond the scope of the tour itself.

He was also a really fun and witty person — a true Sevillian! He helped us understand not just the sights, but the culture and character of Seville itself. Thanks to him, I learned so much and enjoyed every minute of the experience. Highly recommended!
Many thanks to Antonio Jav

title: Unforgettable
text:
Our trip to the Pueblos Blancos (White Villages) was absolutely fantastic, and a huge part of that was thanks to our guide, Iván. We visited Zahara de la Sierra, Grazalema, and Ronda, and each village was more beautiful than the last.
Ivan was incredibly knowledgeable about the history, culture, and nature of the region. He brought each location to life with fascinating stories and insights. What really stood out was his perfect English. He explained everything so clearly and engagingly, making it easy for everyone in our group to understand and appreciate the tour.
